name: CVPR
full_name: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition
summary: 8 頁（不含參考文獻），rebuttal 只有一頁 PDF；引用不存在的文獻會被拒，每位作者最多投 25 篇。

pages.zh: 論文上限 8 頁（含圖表），另可加只含參考文獻的頁面。
pages.quote: Papers are limited to eight pages, including figures and tables, in the CVPR style. Additional pages containing only cited references are allowed.

pages.zh: 未妥善匿名、未用模板或超過 8 頁（不含參考文獻）者不審即拒。
pages.quote: Papers that are not properly anonymized, or do not use the template, or have more than eight pages (excluding references) will be rejected without review.

anonymity.zh: 致謝（如同事、計畫編號）與補充材料中都不得出現可辨識作者的資訊。
anonymity.quote: Do not provide information that may identify the authors in the acknowledgments (e.g., co-workers and grant IDs) nor in the supplementary material
Q. Can I post my submission on arXiv? A. Yes.

anonymity.zh: 錄取前不得與媒體討論投稿論文。
anonymity.quote: Papers submitted to CVPR must not be discussed with the media until they have been officially accepted for publication.

anonymity.zh: 任何把論文稱為「under submission to CVPR」的說法都違反政策。
anonymity.quote: However, please note that any mention of the paper as “under submission to CVPR” is in violation of the policy.

appendix.zh: 可選擇提交因格式或篇幅限制無法放入的補充材料。
appendix.quote: The authors may optionally submit additional material that could not be included due to constraints of format or space.

appendix.zh: 審稿人被鼓勵但沒有義務看補充材料。
appendix.quote: Reviewers will be encouraged to look at it, but are not obligated to do so.

appendix.zh: 補充材料可包含影片、證明、額外圖表、更詳細的實驗分析或投往他處的同期投稿。
appendix.quote: Supplementary material may include videos, proofs, additional figures or tables, more detailed analysis of experiments presented in the paper, or a concurrent submission to another conference.

appendix.zh: 補充 PDF 沒有格式要求，允許單欄排版。
appendix.quote: Formatting supplementary documents in a single-column layout is permitted.

llm.zh: 作者可使用任何工具，但須對論文中的不實陳述、事實錯誤或抄襲負責。
llm.quote: Authors may use any tools they find productive in preparing a paper, but must be aware that they are responsible for any misrepresentation, factual inaccuracy, or plagiarism in their paper.

llm.zh: 引用不存在文獻的論文一經發現即被拒，且可能不審即拒。
llm.quote: Papers containing citations of non-existent material will be rejected when found, and may be rejected without review.

llm.zh: 「是 LLM 做的」不能作為抄襲或錯誤的辯解理由。
llm.quote: It is not a defense to a charge of plagiarism or of inaccuracy to argue that "an LLM did it".

llm.zh: Prompt injection（影響審稿人或工具的隱藏文字/指令）嚴格禁止，視為違反倫理。
llm.quote: Prompt injection: Hidden text or instructions to influence reviewers/tools, is strictly prohibited and considered an ethics violation.

rebuttal.zh: Rebuttal 限一頁 PDF 並使用官方 rebuttal 模板，超過一頁不予審閱。
rebuttal.quote: The rebuttal is limited to a one-page PDF file using the rebuttal template included in the CVPR 2026 Submission Template . Responses longer than one page will simply not be reviewed.

rebuttal.zh: Rebuttal 須保持匿名，不得包含程式碼、影片等外部連結。
rebuttal.quote: The rebuttal must maintain anonymity. It cannot include links to external material such as code, videos, etc.

rebuttal.zh: 作者應避免在 rebuttal 中加入新貢獻或新實驗結果，尤其是未被審稿人要求時。
rebuttal.quote: Authors should refrain from including new contributions or experimental results in the rebuttal, especially when not specifically requested to do so by the reviewers.

rebuttal.zh: 作者可另外給 AC 一則機密留言，但僅限特殊情況。
rebuttal.quote: Authors also have the possibility to submit a separate confidential comment to the area chair. Please do so only in exceptional circumstances.

special.zh: 每位作者最多 25 篇投稿，超過的部分會被 desk reject。
special.quote: Each author is limited to a maximum of 25 paper submissions. If an author registers more than 25 papers, the Program Chairs (PCs) will desk-reject any submissions exceeding this limit.

special.zh: 作者除非獲得豁免，否則會自動加入審稿人名單。
special.quote: Authors will be automatically added to the reviewer pool unless they are exempted.

special.zh: 投稿、補充材料與 rebuttal 中不得放會擴充內容或破壞審稿流程的外部連結。
special.quote: Authors are not allowed to include external links (e.g., to webpages, images, or videos) in submissions, supplementary material, and rebuttal, when the links expand content and subvert the reviewing process.

special.zh: 未完成 OpenReview profile 的作者所屬論文會被 desk reject。
special.quote: Papers with authors who have not completed their profiles will be desk-rejected.
